description:
Change 4/15/26 - Due date discrepancy in RFI attachment has been updated to match due date on SAM.gov of 5/4/26.

Estimated quantity over the life of the contract is also clarified.

The Government is conducting market research to identify qualified vendors capable of providing design-build solutions for Tier 2 Gooseneck Mobile Command Post Vehicle (MCPV) Trailer systems. The anticipated requirement will support a wide range of mission-critical operations requiring rapidly deployable mobile command, control, communications, and computing (C4) capabilities.

The Government is considering a performance-based acquisition approach under a potential Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract. The MCPV systems are expected to be self-contained, highly mobile platforms integrating advanced communications technologies (including satellite, RF, and cellular), onboard power generation, and configurable workspace to support approximately 15–20 workstations.

This RFI seeks industry input on:

  • Technical capabilities and innovative design approaches
  • Integration of communications, power, and vehicle systems
  • Production capacity and delivery timelines
  • Lifecycle sustainment and support strategies
  • Recommended contract structure and performance metrics

The Government is particularly interested in solutions that emphasize modularity, scalability, interoperability, and long-term maintainability.

This notice is issued for information and planning purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation. The Government does not intend to award a contract based on this RFI and will not reimburse respondents for any costs incurred in preparing a response.
